name: Generalized Exponential Splatting
definition: GES is a 3D scene representation that replaces the Gaussian basis functions used in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Generalized Exponential Functions (GEF). It introduces a learnable shape parameter β for each splat to better model signals with sharp edges and high-frequency content, reducing the number of particles required and thus memory footprint while maintaining competitive rendering quality.
